draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.68, the 231st-best grade among 259 2023 draftees and 19th of 20 at S. He went 198th overall, well ahead of where his grade ranked (231st): teams liked him more than the published grade. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 93 tackles in 2022, 4th of 20 Ss in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 4 pro, currently with the Arizona Cardinals (practice squad). 23 career games and 1 starts over 3 completed seasons. Producing near his peak: 0 AV in 2025 against a career-best 0 in 2023. Weak spots: approximate value 0 (1st percentile), passes defended 0 (8th percentile). Played 8 of 17 games in 2025. Versus the typical Year-3 safety who played: 6.8% season snap share against a median of 51.8%, below the norm.
